Every app, the same promises

  • 01

    Free, no sign-up

    No accounts, no paywalls. Open the page and start playing.

  • 02

    Stays on your device

    Your charts and setlists are processed and saved in your browser, never uploaded.

  • 03

    Works offline

    Add any app to your home screen. After the first visit, it opens without a connection.

  • 04

    English and Japanese

    Every app and guide is written in both languages, chosen from your browser.
